releasables.name: Almatia
releasables.notes:
While Almatia has been closely tied to Arovia since the 1500s, there are many in this land of misty hills who despise the sway Meidallan holds over their home. Possessed of a very large Muslim population and a long history as an independent, powerful state in its own right, this has long been the most... unreliable major region of Arovannea. They launched failed revolutionary bids for autonomy in 1820, 1902, and 1944, the last one causing the realisation of a federation in Arovannea. Yet with the centralising and Arovan chauvinist policies of President Illger, this autonomy is now under threat once more.

In the southwest lies the most recalcitrant Almatians of all. Should any government step too harshly on their toes, they will break off the first chance they get.

releasables.name: Nimova
releasables.notes:
Nimova represents a transition of sorts between the old Deltans of Dynatolis and the wild expanses of central Monach. Populated by a partially Aromanised Deltan culture, Nimova has historically been the least stable region of Monach, launching rebellions against whoever rules them time and time again. The most recent war began in 2002, first against Othonia and now against their Arovannean occupiers - as well as the Altuso-Deltan apartheidists to the north.

With Arovannea teetering towards the brink more and more by the day, the Nimovans are seeing their chance at total and final freedom come ever closer.

releasables.name: Ambany
releasables.notes: Ambany is not at all a unified nation culturally. Besides the ever-pervasive Arovan and Iliuri influence, there are a truly stunning number of ethnic groups, religions, and spoken languages in these mountains. The main thing tying them together remains Arovia, historically a guarantor against foreign imperialism. With the heartland itself becoming more erratic and even repressive however, these mountain peoples will have to perhaps find a new unifying trait; otherwise, they will find themselves divided and conquered...

releasables.name: Outer Ambany
releasables.notes:
The most heavily colonised region of Ambany, "Demetria" is defined much more by its separateness from the rest of Arovannea than its unity with the supposed motherland. Historically referring to the northern coast, the term itself is a relatively recent concoction, utilised first by Kampfian colonial authorities only in 1805. The region has long been treated - both by the Ambanese people and Meidallan - as a westward extension of Ambany, in spite of the general dislike the largely Nonscio-Araseotic populace holds towards both. This has historically been the heart of Arovannean Humanism, aided by a relative lack of native Alcatii compared to the rest of the country.

Perhaps surprisingly, Demetrians are quite supportive of the Rugen Presidency, with his granting of autonomy to the region and his increasingly obvious ultraconservative and Humanist tendencies.

releasables.def: the Serkin Salvation and Restoration Government
releasables.name: North Serkin
releasables.notes:
Serkin's collapse in the late 2010s led to a major power vacuum in southwestern Monach, filled rapidly with a string of unstable states, the most recent in this area being first Pakania and then the Federative Republic of Recaxa. The very northernmost peninsula fell to Westmorian and Merlovichian refugees fleeing the chaos One Nation inflicted on the small island, before being annexed by Arovannea to the north. The frontier of the settlement was subdued soon after, and the region was separated from Ambanese control, forming a special federal subject.

Serkinian nationalism runs strong and deep within the Rose Peninsula, as well as a severe hatred of both the Sierro-Serkinians and the Arovanneans. Should chaos take hold, even briefly, in Meidallan...

releasables.name: Baltia
releasables.notes:
Comprised of the descendants of Ostarian and Dumasian pagans, the Beltsers are a people with a remarkably storied history. Mingling with Kampfians and the people in Terreich as they fled southwards, they picked up a substantial number of Saheer along the way. Both groups would make the voyage to Monach, but while the Saheer chose to stay in Nimova, the Beltsers marched over the fierce Andene mountains to found the County of Duesia in 845, on the shores of what was then contested land between Almatian nomad-kings and the Aversarians.
They would be subsumed under the Emirate of Almatia for over five hundred years until the Arovanneans defeated them at the Battle of Rachihash, subduing their former empire and bringing Duesia - now called Baltia - into the fold.

The region has historically held strong loyalties to Arovia, seeing them as their liberator and protector from Almatian designs on their land and culture. But these ties have been weakened - some may argue as a deliberate measure - by recent events; the cession of the north frontier to Sjavolki Aversaria in 1986, various centralising efforts by President Illger, and the passivity of the central government in the face of Islamic encroachment on the largely-pagan Beltsers.  Ties still bind for now, but the special relationship between this little enclave and Meidallan grows increasingly threatened.

Riots, strikes, assassinations and ethnic insurgents will plague our nation!

For five decades, Arovannea has grown increasingly stagnant under the fraudulent rule of several conservative, cronyist governments. For a while it was expected that even the electoral meddling of the New Liberals and Agrarians would not stand up to growing discontent, but in 2034 the Agrarians stole yet another election away from the left and centre, leading to an extreme uptick in political violence and ethnic tension.

With President Illger's insistence on order above all and his controversial attacks on basically every "deviant" element of Arovannean society, it seems this violence will inevitably bathe the country in flames... sooner, rather than later.

The navy has always been Arovannea's ace in the hole, leading her to triumph over the Altusians in 1799 and the Kampfians in 1820. Nowadays, they're being targeted by President Illger as a "politically reticent" faction, accused of anti-Arovannean sentiments and corruption.

In reality, the naval forces have been fairly opposed to the Conservatives of Arovannea dominating and subduing national politics, and many in their ranks await the opportunity to strike and truly restore the Republic.

1772,1727.note:
Grand Mosque of Jiyansivuan
Grants +7.5% stability and +7.5% war support

The largest and oldest surviving mosque west of Usnistan, this magnificent building was erected on the orders of the second Emir of Almatia, Cuylir, in 1009 CE. Having survived Altusian invasions, civil wars, and the fall of the Emirate, it stands as a homage to the strength of the Almatian people and their traditions.

1983,1683.note:
The Silver Palace
Grants +25% ideology drift defence and +5% division attack/defence on core territory

The Federal and Presidential Residence - historically the Silver Palace - was constructed during the reign of Hlan X Nysylat in 870 CE. The Basilica of Saint Athel and Holy Life attached to the palace was erected a century later, standing as the oldest such structure south of the equator. 

The palace, formerly the main residence of the Thalassors of Arovia, saw the inauguration of the first President of the Republic in 1897, and serves today as the seat of executive power in Arovannea.
